card_lines: Sigils are the weakest part of Alchemy (tier 1/8). Only Autistachio is charging one. Quickest next levels: Big Muscle, Pumped Kicks, Odd Litearture.
The Loot Pile sigil (more sailing chests) would take one character about 15 days. Griffy rates it as a good pick.
Seats follow the biggest need: move someone onto sigils only while something is waiting on them, and never empty the cauldrons. Griffy: finish unlocking bubbles before worrying about sigils.
Bubble goals: Dream Of Ironfish 82 -> 170; Warriors Rule (Printing!) 436 -> 450; Hearty Diggy 570 -> 900; Stronk Tools 402 -> 630.

Autisticles: Alchemy (Cat): Loot Pile sigil adds sailing chest capacity, 0/23,000 undiscovered
